description: This Java source file defines an Android activity that demonstrates package installation using the PackageInstaller.Session API. It includes methods for creating an installation session, adding an APK to the session, committing the session to start installation, and handling installation status updates.

classes.name: InstallApkSessionApi
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating package installation via the PackageInstaller Session API.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, setting the layout and defining button click behavior for initiating APK installation.

methods.name: addApkToInstallSession
methods.description: Reads an APK asset and writes it into the installation session.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles callbacks with the result of the installation, displaying success or failure messages.
